hypothesis: Reparameterizing penalty work as a first-row baseline plus additional rows, and masking as shared activation plus singleton overhead, may improve the black-box fitter's attribution while preserving the observed cost regimes.

pcvs.name: penalties_enabled
pcvs.rationale: Models the complete single-request penalty path.

pcvs.name: additional_penalty_rows
pcvs.rationale: Models incremental penalty work beyond the first request, separating it from the single-request baseline.

pcvs.expression: int(sampling_metadata.no_penalties and sum((len(getattr(processor, 'logits_slice', ([], []))[0]) for processor in sampling_metadata.logitsprocs.non_argmax_invariant)) > 0)
pcvs.name: unpenalized_mask_active
pcvs.rationale: Captures masking overhead shared by both observed unpenalized masking cases.

pcvs.expression: int(sampling_metadata.no_penalties and sum((len(getattr(processor, 'logits_slice', ([], []))[0]) for processor in sampling_metadata.logitsprocs.non_argmax_invariant)) == 1)
pcvs.name: unpenalized_single_mask
pcvs.rationale: Captures the additional cost observed for singleton masking.
